title: Chestnut Hill Home & Garden Festival

Soar on the flying trapeze. Solve a Mona Lisa mystery. Take a ride on a Ferris wheel... on Broad Street.

title: WOW! Wee Ones at Winterthur

Registration requested, but not required.

description: Community days are scheduled throughout the year and spotlight different neighborhoods that make up our “river city." Special admission price of $5 for Fishtown residents!

title: Little Explorers

Nature programs include an outdoor walk & an indoor activity. Age 3. Children must be accompanied by an adult.

Animal Homes, March 7. Read If You Were My Baby by Fran Hodkins & go for a hike to look for animal homes.

Seeing is Believing, March 13. Search for spring flowers & a bird's bathtub and meet tree families.

Move Like a Fox!, March 21. Learn how different animals move.

Bird Beaks, March 28. Learn about the many things birds can do with their beaks.

Animals are Sleeping, April 4. Read Animals are Sleeping by Suzanne Slade, then search for animal resting places.

A Tale of Tails, April 11. Listen to stories about animal tails.

Spring Colors, April 18. See the first flowers of spring.

Welcome Back Spring!, April 25. Use your senses to investigate weather, plants & animals and experience how spring arrives at the Arboretum.

Nature Investigator, May 2. Explore the great outdoors and find the many textures & colors of nature.

First Vegetables, March 15. Help us plant peas, beets & cabbage in the garden, then plant a container to take home.

What Smells?, March 22. Go on a "sniff hunt" to find different smells in nature.

Tough Flowers, March 29. Join a flower hunt & plant Johnny-Jump-Ups.

Buried Treasures, April 5. Learn what daffodils & onions have in common as you dig up & plant buried botanical treasures.

Plants in a Tiny Package, April 12. Learn all about seeds.

Roots & Shoots, April 19. Discover how plants drink water.

Leafing Out, April 26. Discover the many shapes & sizes of leaves, and which ones are good to eat.

Flower Power, May 3. Explore the beauty of flowers.

Twisters, Scramblers & Climbers, May 10. Learn how vines reach for the sky as you plant some vegetable & flower climbers.

Fruits and Veggies, May 17. Explore the many types of fruits & enjoy a taste test.

Busy Bees, May 24. Learn how bees help flowers grow.
